mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO service_account ( cors_account_id, account, owner_company_id, assigned_user_id, source_service_code_id, exchange_batch_id, exchange_detail_id, service_type, duration_value, duration_unit, account_silence_months, exchange_at, force_activate_at, cors_status, cors_activation_status, activated_at, expire_at, cors_created_at, cors_updated_at, last_sync_at, version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES
( #{item.corsAccountId}, #{item.account}, #{item.ownerCompanyId}, #{item.assignedUserId}, #{item.sourceServiceCodeId}, #{item.exchangeBatchId}, #{item.exchangeDetailId}, #{item.serviceType}, #{item.durationValue}, #{item.durationUnit}, #{item.accountSilenceMonths}, #{item.exchangeAt}, #{item.forceActivateAt}, #{item.corsStatus}, #{item.corsActivationStatus}, #{item.activatedAt}, #{item.expireAt}, #{item.corsCreatedAt}, #{item.corsUpdatedAt}, #{item.lastSyncAt}, #{item.version}, #{item.createdAt}, #{item.updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM service_account WHERE cors_account_id IS NOT NULL AND cors_account_id <> '' AND cors_activation_status = 'WAITING_ACTIVATION' AND (status_sync_next_at IS NULL OR status_sync_next_at <= #{now}) ORDER BY status_sync_next_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id FROM service_account WHERE cors_account_id IS NOT NULL AND cors_account_id <> '' AND (cors_activation_status IS NULL OR cors_activation_status <> 'WAITING_ACTIVATION') AND (status_sync_next_at IS NULL OR status_sync_next_at <= #{now}) ORDER BY status_sync_next_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT account.id FROM service_account account WHERE account.cors_account_id IS NOT NULL AND account.cors_account_id <> '' AND account.cors_activation_status = 'WAITING_ACTIVATION' AND account.force_activate_at IS NOT NULL AND account.force_activate_at <= #{now} AND (account.status_sync_next_at IS NULL OR account.status_sync_next_at <= #{now}) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM cors_operation operation WHERE operation.biz_type = 'ACCOUNT_FORCE_ACTIVATION' AND operation.biz_id = account.id ) ORDER BY account.force_activate_at, account.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE service_account SET cors_status = #{update.corsStatus}, cors_activation_status = #{update.corsActivationStatus}, activated_at = #{update.activatedAt}, expire_at = #{update.expireAt}, cors_created_at = COALESCE(cors_created_at, #{update.corsCreatedAt}), cors_updated_at = #{update.corsUpdatedAt}, last_sync_at = #{update.lastSyncAt}, status_sync_last_attempt_at = #{update.statusSyncLastAttemptAt}, status_sync_next_at = #{update.statusSyncNextAt}, status_sync_failure_count = 0, updated_at = #{update.updatedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{update.id} AND version = #{update.expectedVersion}

UPDATE service_account SET last_sync_at = #{update.lastSyncAt}, status_sync_last_attempt_at = #{update.lastAttemptAt}, status_sync_next_at = #{update.nextAt}, status_sync_failure_count = 0, updated_at = #{update.updatedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{update.id} AND version = #{update.expectedVersion}

UPDATE service_account SET status_sync_last_attempt_at = #{update.lastAttemptAt}, status_sync_next_at = #{update.nextAt}, status_sync_failure_count = #{update.failureCount}, updated_at = #{update.updatedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{update.id} AND version = #{update.expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT id, cors_account_id, account, cors_status, cors_activation_status, activated_at, expire_at, cors_created_at, cors_updated_at, last_sync_at, status_sync_failure_count, version FROM service_account WHERE id > #{lastId} AND cors_account_id IS NOT NULL AND cors_account_id <> '' AND account IS NOT NULL AND account <> '' ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
